description: All member sizes are R2 indicative sizes (central scenario). Strength, flexural-torsional buckling of double angles and Class 4 6 mm legs (70-75 mm angles in S355) unchecked.
Bolt counts follow the R2 take-off rule (max(2, F/100 kN) per web end; 4 chord bolts; 8 splice bolts). No bolt group, gusset, block tearing or net-section design.
Splice plates (8 mm placeholder) splice the connected legs only; outstanding legs unspliced. R2 recommends preloaded splice bolts or pre-camber (bolt slip). Shop vs site splices undecided.
Truss-to-column bearing not designed; existing cap plate and 16 mm seat fin conflict with the heel (clash group C-01). Holding-down for ~80 kN uplift (R2).
Eaves wind girders / wall bracing (R2 ~10.6 t) and bottom-chord ties at <= 5.4 m are required and not modelled; existing rod-bracing end plates conflict with gussets (C-03).
R2 recommends designing the rigging trusses for the future scenario (BC 2L100, TC 2L90/2L100). Modelled at the R2 central basis. Rigging tab provisions have no rated capacity.
R2 analysed lines 0, 1, 2 and 4 only; lines 8-9 (edge-zone wind coefficients) adopt the line-4 sizes.
Top of steel set on the existing purlin seat (10.5 mm below R2's 12.380 line): centroid depth 1.444-1.447 m at bearing vs R2 1.48 m (-2.4 %), 5.784 m at ridge vs 5.82 m. Confirm in design analysis.
affects: member forces at the heel panels

description: S355JR assumed for members and plates (plate grade not in R2); availability and certification to confirm; S275 sensitivity in R2.
Two-coat paint assumed (R2 cost basis); hot-dip galvanising decision pending (R2 s.11.3; bath length for 6 m members).
M20 8.8 (R2 working assumption), M16 on 60 mm legs (placeholder); washer count, hole type, preload, coating not specified.
No execution class or tolerance specification (EN 1090 / SANS 2001-CS1).
Splice plates on 2L80 chords give a 25 mm edge distance at M20 (EN 1993-1-8 minimum 1.2 d0 = 26.4 mm). Placeholder detail; resolve at design (wider plate, M16, or 2L90).
Packers at <= 1.2 m clear (R2 rule) - verify against SANS 10162-1 / EN 1993-1-1 6.4.4 for compression members.
Bolt holes are modelled in plates (voids) but not in angles; angle masses are gross nominal (BOQ convention).
Existing purlin cleats sit ~14 mm above the new top of steel; purlin package to re-detail.

Raft clamps, lighting hangers, HVLS beams and arrays are off the 2.70 m panel points and have no designed attachments; rigging load plan, fan dynamic assessment and catwalk decision outstanding (R2 s.9-11).
Measured quantities are MODEL_DERIVED for concept-size members; bolts, packers and splice plates are ASSUMPTION_DEPENDENT. No waste, spares, rates or amounts applied. Not procurement-ready.
